notes.title: A Saints Row: Gat out of Hell Update has been released
notes.content:
Saints Row: Gat out of Hell Patch Notes:

- Fixed an issue where some users were not seeing one of the final cutscenes
- Fixed an issue where the game would crash if DLC hair from Saints Row IV: Re-Elected was worn by The Boss in the opening cutscene
